The customer authorizes the plan and the business teammate accepts in a separate laptop tab. Ask an unknown preference immediately after the opening, before the service answers. Whether another color is acceptable was not supplied in the interview. The authorized placeholder accepts black only if waterproof and about 20 liters. Actual PR runs ended at 15:27, 15:33 and 15:37 KST. The third captured an explicit alternative-color question that Realtime skipped. No live relay or normal completion passed. Team-defined YOKOBU v2 scope, including the later instruction to use separate tabs on this laptop instead of two actual phones. No real telephone calls or real institution search. User value is Unverified. Official submission: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/#process . Official three-minute guide: https://ralphthon.org/kakao-ai-dot-2026/student-preparation.pdf .
2:00–2:30. Automated checks: 64 unit, 30 localhost HTTP with mocked AI and blocked upstream network, 20 mocked customer UI, 16 mocked business UI, and 32 design checks. The build and eight extracted-archive checks passed. These do not establish a successful live microphone conversation. The real PR microphone attempts captured Korean speech, but the teammate reported repeated questions and an ignored business question. The third run recorded navy unavailable and price 10,000 won regardless of color. Pickup speech was ambiguous in transcription and remained unresolved. A Korean parenthetical also caused the summary language guard to withhold the stock answer. Fixes include serialized playback, server detection of explicit customer questions, precise unresolved-question control, and retaining saved transcript metadata in HTTP confirmation review. The last defect could reject a valid confirmation even when isolated state tests passed. The new HTTP regression covers readback and final completion. A three-request real API replay of the recorded business question opens an English relay and faithfully translates the synthetic placeholder reply into Korean. This replay is not a new microphone or audible-return test. A prior recorded summary regression passed nine checks with one provider request and preserved uncertain price. Full live relay and normal completion remain unverified. Source: docs/v2-pr1-review.md; artifacts/v2/pr1-recorded-question-relay-replay.json; artifacts/v2/http-check.json. Korean audibility was explicitly confirmed for the first short hospital attempt only. English, Russian and Chinese UI tests pass; prior real language checks still disclose fidelity limitations. User value remains unverified.
